proposals: The Oil Industry Safety Directorate should publish anonymised annual statistics on loss-of-containment incidents attributed to corrosion under insulation at Indian oil and gas facilities, with floating units shown separately, so that the risk to FSRUs and FPSOs is measured rather than extrapolated from onshore data held privately elsewhere.

The Oil Industry Safety Directorate should state whether its standards require risk-based CUI management for insulated piping on FSRUs and FPSOs in Indian waters, and add that requirement if they do not, with explicit inspection of stainless sections in the chloride-cracking temperature band that thickness gauges can miss.

PNGRB should require FSRU terminal operators to report monthly LNG boil-off and regasification efficiency, since insulation that has taken on salt water shows up as rising boil-off well before a leak, giving regulators and operators an early public indicator of hidden degradation.
